blocks.text: Mark 6 contains 56 verses. It opens with: And he went out from thence; and he cometh into his own country; and his disciples follow him. It concludes with: And wheresoever he entered, into villages, or into cities, or into the country, they laid the sick in the marketplaces, and besought him that they might touch if it were but the border of his garment: and as many as touched him were made whole.
